title: 20" pillow inserts for covers
text: 20" pillow inserts for covers. These are not the fullest pillows I've ever purchased, however, if they are TOO fluffy you can't get them into your covers.  All in all, these were perfect for the 18x18" covers I purchased.  Just right. - Yes, I purchased 20" pillows for 18x18" covers.  You want your pillows to fully fill your covers, corner to corner.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Throw Pillows Insert (Pack of 2, Navy) - 12 x 20 Inches Bed and Couch Pillows - Indoor Decorative Pillows
features: THROW PILLOW PACK - Pack of 2 decorative throw pillows for your couches or bedroom; they are neither too big nor too small and they give off a homely vibe
PACKAGING - Pillows are compressed in vacuum packaging because of shipping purpose, they might appear as one large pillow.
DIMENSIONS - Each pillow insert measures 12 by 20 inches
MATERIAL COMPOSITION – 115 GSM Brushed Fabric and siliconized fiber filling will never make them look hollow
SOFT AND DURABLE - The pillows are designed to give a delicate feel while retaining long term durability
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - It is recommended to spot clean the pillow or hand wash the fabric
